// @molis-ai/molis-work-plugin-sdk/subtask-conversation: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export interface AgentSubtaskSourcePorts {
    drafts: UiPageDrafts;
    labels: MwComposerAiLabels;
    text: UiTextTool["text"];
    read(target: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<AgentSubtaskRead>;
    command(target: string, command: AgentSubagentCommand, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<AgentSubagentRequestResult & {
        details?: {
            errors?: Record<string, string>;
        };
    }>;
    check(target: string, requestId: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<AgentSubagentRequestResult>;
    subscribe?: SubtaskConversationSource["subscribe"];
    wait?(target: string, since: string | null, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<AgentSubtaskWait>;
    action?: SubtaskConversationSource["act"];
}

export type SubtaskActionOutcome = {
    readonly state: "applied";
} | {
    readonly state: "not-applied";
    readonly reason: string;
    readonly errors?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
} | {
    readonly state: "unknown";
    readonly check: () => Promise<SubtaskActionOutcome>;
};

export type SubtaskComposerOptions = Omit<Extract<ComposerOptions, {
    kind: "ai";
}>, "draft" | "placement" | "stop" | "pause"> & {
    readonly draft: {
        readonly adapter: ComposerDraftAdapter;
    };
};

export interface SubtaskConversationHandle {
    open(target: string): Promise<void>;
    refresh(): Promise<void>;
    close(): void;
    destroy(): void;
}

export interface SubtaskConversationOptions {
    readonly labels: MwSubtaskConversationLabels;
    readonly source: SubtaskConversationSource;
    mountDetail?(root: HTMLElement, view: MwSubtaskConversationView, detail: MwSubtaskDetail, submit: (action: MwSubtaskAction) => Promise<SubtaskActionOutcome | undefined>): {
        update?(view: MwSubtaskConversationView, detail: MwSubtaskDetail): void;
        destroy(): void;
    } | undefined;
    onBack(parent: MwSubtaskLink | undefined): void;
    onClose(): void;
}

export type SubtaskConversationRead = {
    readonly state: "available";
    readonly view: MwSubtaskConversationView;
} | {
    readonly state: "denied";
    readonly reason: string;
};

export interface SubtaskConversationSource {
    read(target: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<SubtaskConversationRead>;
    subscribe?(target: string, invalidate: () => void, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<() => void>;
    composer(view: MwSubtaskConversationView): SubtaskComposerOptions;
    check(target: string, requestId: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<SubtaskActionOutcome>;
    act(view: MwSubtaskConversationView, action: MwSubtaskAction, requestId: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<SubtaskActionOutcome>;
}

export interface SubtaskPending {
    readonly requestId: string;
    readonly kind: "input" | "action";
    readonly binding: string;
    readonly revision: number;
    readonly action?: {
        readonly id: string;
        readonly ref: string;
    };
}

export declare function createAgentSubtaskSource(ports: AgentSubtaskSourcePorts): SubtaskConversationSource & {
    flush(): Promise<void>;
};

export declare function createSubtaskConversation(root: HTMLElement, options: SubtaskConversationOptions): SubtaskConversationHandle;

export declare function createSubtaskQuestions(ports: {
    drafts: UiPageDrafts;
    interaction(root: HTMLElement, host: InteractionClientHost): InteractionClient;
    draft?(target: string, binding: string, question: AgentPendingQuestion): (ComposerDraftAdapter & {
        flush(): Promise<unknown>;
    }) | undefined;
    text(key: string): string;
}): {
    mount: (root: HTMLElement, view: import("ui/subtask-conversation").MwSubtaskConversationView, detail: MwSubtaskDetail, submit: (action: import("ui/subtask-conversation").MwSubtaskAction) => Promise<import("browser/subtask-contract").SubtaskActionOutcome | undefined>) => {
        update?(view: import("ui/subtask-conversation").MwSubtaskConversationView, detail: MwSubtaskDetail): void;
        destroy(): void;
    } | undefined;
    remember(target: string, binding: string, found: readonly DrawnQuestion[]): MwSubtaskDetail[];
    flush(): Promise<void>;
};

export declare function subscribeSubtask<Update extends {
    version: string;
}>(read: (since: string | null, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<Update>, invalidate: (update?: Update) => void, signal: AbortSignal, first?: (update: Update) => void): Promise<() => void>;

export declare function subtaskDraft(store: UiPageDrafts, target: string): {
    adapter: ComposerDraftAdapter;
    flush: () => Promise<void>;
    pendings(): Promise<SubtaskPending[]>;
    pending(): Promise<SubtaskPending | undefined>;
    begin(requestId: string, kind: SubtaskPending["kind"], binding: string, text?: string, options?: {
        action?: SubtaskPending["action"];
        alongside?(pending: SubtaskPending): boolean;
        signal?: AbortSignal;
    }): Promise<void>;
    settle: (requestId: string, accepted: boolean) => Promise<void>;
    cancelUnsent: (requestId: string, reason: string) => Promise<SubtaskActionOutcome>;
    checkUnsent(requestId: string, reason: string): Promise<SubtaskActionOutcome | undefined>;
};

// Declarations the exports above refer to, which no entry exports itself:

type AgentSubtaskRead = {
    conversation: AgentSubagentConversation;
    parent: MwSubtaskLink;
    children?: MwSubtaskLink[];
    details?: MwSubtaskDetail[];
};

type AgentSubtaskWait = {
    version: string;
    snapshot?: AgentSubtaskRead;
};

type DrawnQuestion = AgentPendingQuestion & {
    html?: string;
};
